title: RiskSignal
description: Predictive risk signal published by a Site Agent and consumed by peer agents and the NetworkBrain.

site_id.description: Identifier of the facility that produced this signal.

congestion_probability.description: Probability (0–1) that the site will experience throughput congestion within the prediction horizon.

failure_likelihood.description: Probability (0–1) of a robot or subsystem failure within the prediction horizon.

recovery_latency_seconds.description: Estimated seconds required to return to normal operations after a fault.

composite_score.description: Effective risk score used for inter-agent prioritisation.

site_risk_score.description: Generic site-level risk score from congestion, failure, and recovery-latency evidence.

local_anomaly_score.description: Observable robot-level anomaly risk score derived from suspect-robot task/service behavior relative to peers.

level.description: Discrete risk level derived from composite_score.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) when this signal was generated.
